draft.title: Local or Free TTS for Short American English Dialogues with Gender Voice Options?
draft.body: A user reported trying Coqui TTS (XTTS v2) locally for generating short dialogues between two speakers with natural American English accents, hoping to switch speaker genders (male/male, male/female, female/female). However, they found the output quality poor and are seeking alternatives beyond online services like ElevenLabs. Given their lack of programming experience and reliance on step-by-step guides, are there any known local or free TTS tools that handle multi-speaker dialogues with distinct, natural-sounding American English voices and flexible gender configuration? Insights on ease of setup and voice quality tradeoffs would be especially helpful.
